items.description: Arrange for the surveyor to conduct the hatch cover hose test and inspection of hold no.4 coamings for VSL-03 at the next port on 2026-10-14.
Review the survey quote of USD 2,950 for the hatch cover hose test and inspection for VSL-03.
Seek internal approval for the survey quote of USD 2,950 for VSL-03's hatch cover hose test and inspection.
